description: Graphics plugin for Nintendo 64 emulators, bundled with the GlideHQ texture enhancer and Glitch64 Glide3x wrapper
notes: This is the final Glide64 release (10th Anniversary Release) and is no longer developed.
This is a graphics plugin for N64 emulators (Project64, 1964, Mupen64, etc.).
Copy Glide64.dll, Glide64.ini and GlideHQ.dll from $dir\Plugin and glide3x.dll from $dir\Wrapper into your emulator's plugin directory.
